changelog:
Initial release of FreeRide skill for OpenClaw.

- Adds automated management of free AI models from OpenRouter.
- Automatically selects and ranks free models for primary and fallback use, updating only relevant config fields.
- Provides CLI commands for listing models, switching, and checking status.
- Includes instructions for setup, configuration, and troubleshooting.
- Supports optional watcher for automatic model rotation on rate limits.
